title: IndexFill primitive rejects documented scalar value arguments
duplicate_search_queries: site:gitee.com/mindspore/mindspore/issues IndexFill value must be Tensor got Int64 MindSpore
site:github.com/mindspore-ai/mindspore/issues IndexFill value Union bool int float Tensor
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found for IndexFill scalar value rejection.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 IndexFill primitive docs list value as Union[bool, int, float, Tensor] and list CPU as a supported platform.
MindSpore 2.9 ops.index_fill docs also list value as Union[bool, int, float, Tensor].
The functional ops.index_fill and Tensor.index_fill wrappers accept the same scalar int value in both PyNative and Graph mode, so the failure is localized to direct primitive invocation.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the failing path raises before producing a tensor.
Not a CPU unsupported issue: the primitive docs list CPU support, Tensor-valued value controls pass, and functional/Tensor wrappers pass on CPU.
The rejected values are ordinary documented scalar values: int and float.
The direct primitive error is TypeError: 'the type of input argument[value] must be Tensor'.
